description: This Java test class 'HttpUrlTest' contains unit tests for the 'HttpUrl' class, verifying URL validation logic for HTTP and HTTPS protocols and proper exception handling.

classes.name: HttpUrlTest
classes.description: Unit test class for HttpUrl, testing URL validation scenarios.

methods.name: constructor_shouldNotThrowExceptionIfItIsAnHttpUrl
methods.description: Tests that the constructor accepts a valid HTTP URL without throwing exceptions.

methods.name: constructor_shouldNotThrowExceptionIfItIsAnHttpsUrl
methods.description: Tests that the constructor accepts a valid HTTPS URL.

methods.name: constructor_shouldThrowMalformedUrlExceptionIfTheUrlDoesNotHaveHttp
methods.description: Ensures that URLs not starting with http or https throw a MalformedURLException with the appropriate message.

methods.name: constructor_shouldNotAllowNullUrls
methods.description: Checks that passing null to the constructor throws a MalformedURLException with message 'Url cannot be null'.

methods.name: toString_shouldReturnUrl
methods.description: Verifies that the toString method returns the original URL string for HTTP URLs.

methods.name: toString_shouldReturnUrlHttps
methods.description: Verifies that the toString method returns the original URL string for HTTPS URLs.
